workflow: Use plain `git worktree add` (not EnterWorktree) when you need to stay in the current checkout to keep driving one piece of work while spinning up an isolated worktree for a second, independent piece of work.

When network fetch is unavailable in a sandboxed session, a recent local origin/main ref can still be treated as current if it matches the known base of other recently-created branches — but verify the resulting worktree contents match expectations before trusting it (e.g., check for stray directories from other branches).
